states.name: First open (stylesheet question)
headStyles: #shortcuts { color:var(--nk-text); background:var(--nk-chrome); border:1px solid var(--nk-line); border-radius:12px; padding:24px; width:min(760px,90vw); max-height:85vh; box-shadow:var(--nk-shadow-pop); font:12px/1.5 var(--nk-sans) } #shortcuts::backdrop { background:#0005 } #shortcuts header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center } #shortcuts h2 { font-size:17px; margin:0 } #shortcuts p { color:var(--nk-text-2) } #shortcuts dl { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:0 24px } #shortcuts .shortcut { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:12px; border-top:1px solid var(--nk-line); padding:9px 0; break-inside:avoid } #shortcuts dt { max-width:55% } #shortcuts dd { margin:0; text-align:right; font:10px var(--nk-mono); color:var(--nk-text-2) } #shortcuts button { border:1px solid var(--nk-line); background:var(--nk-chrome-2); border-radius:6px; padding:5px 10px } @media(max-width:650px) { #shortcuts dl { grid-template-columns:1fr } }
#world .mount, #world .preview-inner, #stage .ghost-new .preview-inner {}

#empty-state { position:absolute; left:50%; top:44%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:330px; padding:24px; color:var(--nk-text); background:var(--nk-chrome); border:1px solid var(--nk-line); border-radius:12px; box-shadow:var(--nk-frame-shadow); font:12px/1.6 var(--nk-sans); z-index:1 } #empty-state h2 { font-size:17px; margin:0 0 6px; font-weight:600 } #empty-state p { color:var(--nk-text-2); margin:0 0 18px } #empty-state button { width:100%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border:1px solid var(--nk-line); border-radius:7px; padding:9px 12px; color:var(--nk-text); background:var(--nk-chrome-2); margin-bottom:16px } #empty-state dl { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:8px 12px; margin:0; color:var(--nk-text-2) } #empty-state dd { margin:0; text-align:right } #empty-state small { display:block; margin-top:18px; color:var(--nk-text-3) }
